method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual taxpayer, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (nonresidents, part-year residents, years before 2024 and 'who must file' answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: Resident individuals, calendar taxable years from 2024: s 12-700(a), (a)(10)(A)-(D) (schedules, 2% bracket phase-out, recaptures); s 12-701(a)(1), (a)(8); s 12-702(a)(1), (a)(2)(I), (b), (c); s 12-703(a)(1), (a)(2)(I), (b), (c); s 12-704e(a)-(c) (2026 Supp.); s 12-719(a); s 12-732(a)(1) (no extension case); s 12-735(a), (b). Connecticut AGI (s 12-701(a)(20)), federal filing status, and the federal EIC are inputs. Out: nonresidents and part-year residents, years before 2024, fiscal years, trusts and estates, AMT, the (a)(20) modifications, other credits, withholding and estimated tax, extensions, assessments and appeals.
seat: the individual taxpayer resident in Connecticut for the whole taxable year
